title: Choosing the compute: request profile, cost model and effort to migrate

videos.script: Three teams ask the same question. Which compute should we use? {{three}} One runs an order API that never quite sleeps. One runs a tool people open in office hours. One answers a partner's system, a few calls a minute, all day. They should not get the same answer, and this lesson shows why. {{profile}} It starts with the traffic, written down as 24 numbers, one per hour. You read four things off it. The volume, the peak, the idle hours, and how long a request takes. {{program}} Then a short program prices each profile five ways. Two virtual machines, Container Apps, App Service, Functions and AKS. The rates in it are illustrative, not Azure's, and you will see where the real ones go. {{limits}} Price is half the decision. The other half is what the move asks of your code. A container, or a function signature. No orders kept in memory. And an answer inside four minutes, whatever the timeout says. {{shop}} Last, the shop takes the whole decision. It starts from its traffic, and it ends with the numbers that would make it change its mind.
